description: This PHP source file defines the class Smarty_CacheResource_Memcache, which implements a cache resource for Smarty using Memcache/Memcached as the storage backend. It provides methods for reading, writing, deleting, and purging cache entries, utilizing memcache instances and handling key hashing with sha1 to accommodate key length limitations.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Memcache
classes.description: Implements a cache resource for Smarty using Memcache or Memcached as the backend, providing methods for cache read, write, delete, and purge operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcache/Memcached instance and adds a server at 127.0.0.1:11211.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches values for a set of keys from cache, returning an associative array.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores a set of key-value pairs in cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes specified keys from the cache.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears all cache entries from the memcache server.
